text: Became President of the Clemson Quantum Club
Presenting a poster on MEDA, our measurement-efficient Majorana zero mode detection framework, at Clemson HPC Day
Started my Ph.D. in Civil Engineering at Clemson University, researching quantum ML, cybersecurity, and cyber-physical systems in Dr. Chowdhury's group
MEDA, our paper on measurement-efficient disorder-aware detection of Majorana zero modes, accepted at IEEE QCE 2026
Graduated from Clemson University with a B.S. in Physics and a minor in Italian Studies
Won 3rd place at YQuantum 2026 at Yale for cat qubit control optimization with team (Ψ)ceratops
Won 1st place at iQuHACK 2026 at MIT with a Reed-Muller decoding-based Clifford+T circuit optimizer (Superquantum challenge)
Selected as an IBM Qiskit Advocate
Co-authored a paper on chiral phonons in layered AgCrP₂Se₆, published in ACS Nano
Presented NeurotiQ at NYUAD Quantum Hackathon in Abu Dhabi
Competed in SC Quantathon v2, building quantum kernels for tornado prediction
Competed at iQuHACK 2025 at MIT in the cat qubit simulation challenge
Won 1st place and the grand prize overall at the inaugural SC Quantathon for quantum random number generation on IBM hardware
Joined the Clemson Nanomaterials Institute as an undergraduate research assistant
